changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO student_attempt (enrollment_id, task_id, started_at, submitted_at) SELECT e.id, tq.task_id, DATEADD(DAY, -v.value, GETDATE()), DATEADD(MINUTE, 30, DATEADD(DAY, -v.value, GETDATE())) FROM (SELECT TOP 100 id FROM enrollment ORDER BY id) e CROSS JOIN (SELECT TOP 500 task_id FROM task_quiz tq INNER JOIN task t ON tq.task_id = t.id WHERE t.title LIKE 'mock[_]task[_]%') tq CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(1, 3) v;
